name: Foundever (Partner)
desc:
Licensed Personal Lines Insurance Specialist | $19/hr + bonus incentives ($18/hr during paid training) | Inbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: Foundever
Industry: Insurance / Customer Experience (CX) Outsourcing
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be answering inbound calls only, no cold calling here, for insurance clients covering things like life, health, property and casualty, retirement planning, and warranty products. Callers reach out with questions or issues, and you'd use your Personal Lines license to actually help them with real policy matters, not just general customer service. You'd navigate company systems to find answers, resolve concerns with empathy, and keep your license active through paid continuing education along the way. It's steady phone work with a real licensing credential behind it, giving the role more depth than a typical call center job.

skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED equivalent, required
Required Experience: Active Producer Personal Lines Insurance License (required), NPN number needed for application
Preferred Experience: 6 months to 2 years of relevant work experience
Required Skills:
Strong customer service aptitude and basic conflict resolution
Reliability and consistent dependability
Critical thinking and ability to assess situations with empathy
Strong organizational skills
Ability to navigate system tools to find answers
Self-paced learner able to complete continuing education to keep the license active
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
A participant who already holds or is close to earning a Personal Lines insurance license through your licensing pathway
Someone comfortable with inbound-only phone work, no sales pressure or cold calling involved
Someone reliable with open availability, including weekend shifts as needed
Someone who enjoys ongoing learning, since continuing education is required and paid for by Foundever
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone without an active Personal Lines Producer license, this is a hard requirement, not a preference
Anyone who cannot commit to open availability including weekends
Anyone who is a primary caregiver during working hours, since the posting specifically states this isn't compatible with the role
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience holding a Personal Lines insurance license.
Walk us through how you'd handle a caller who is frustrated about a policy issue.
What's your approach to staying current with continuing education requirements?
How do you stay organized when navigating multiple systems to find an answer during a call?
This role requires open availability including weekends, how do you feel about that schedule?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $19 per hour plus bonus incentive opportunities. Paid training pays $18 per hour
Shift: Flexible remote schedule, no less than 40 hours per week, with weekend shifts as needed
Benefits: 401(k) matching, health, dental, and vision insurance, disability insurance, paid time off, bonus opportunities, and career growth paths
Equipment Provided: Yes, Foundever ships necessary equipment including a headset. Participant is responsible for a hardwired high-speed internet connection and a quiet, distraction-free workspace, with webcam presence required during training and production
Felony Friendly?: Not stated
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes: This is an excellent fit for your P&C or L&H licensing pathway participants, since holding an active Personal Lines license is the defining requirement here, and Foundever pays for the continuing education needed to keep it active. Being inbound-only with no cold calling is a nice selling point for participants who might feel hesitant about a sales-heavy insurance role.
Career Pathway: Remote Licensed Personal Lines Insurance Specialist → Senior Insurance Specialist → Team Lead or Quality Assurance Specialist
